name: mixmax-leader-update-slides
description: End-of-month and end-of-quarter Update Slides for the Mixmax CEO's board/exec deck. Generates two slide-by-slide HTML briefs (Sales + CS) inheriting numbers from the most recently approved Mixmax Monthly or Quarterly Revenue Report. Each brief mirrors the deck the CEO writes himself — one chart + drafted bullets + writing guidance per slide. Publishes to GitHub Pages. Requires mixmax-publishing-core.
